cohort: The study enrolled 165 women with spontaneous preterm delivery between 24+0 and 36+6 gestational weeks and compared them to an external group of 30 women with term delivery.
finding: Women with spontaneous preterm delivery had lower total cholesterol and LDL-cholesterol levels and higher glucose levels compared to women with term delivery, though a general association with unfavorable lipids and cardiovascular biochemical risk factors was not established.
gest_age: 24+0 to 36+6 gestational weeks for the sPTD group, and mean 40.3 +- 1.3 weeks for the term delivery group
